title: Executive Sponsor
description: Strategic decision-maker and budget owner. Approves project charter, resolves escalations, and ensures alignment with organisational goals.

title: Product Owner
description: Owns the product backlog and represents business value. Prioritises features, accepts deliverables, and is the single voice of the customer in the team.

title: Business Analyst
description: Bridges business needs and technical solutions. Elicits, models, and documents requirements. Owns discovery and specification artefacts.

title: Tech Lead
description: Leads the development team technically. Reviews architecture decisions, sets coding standards, and resolves technical blockers.

title: Solution Architect
description: Designs the overall technical solution. Owns architecture decisions, non-functional requirements, and integration patterns across systems.

title: Developer
description: Implements features and fixes. Writes code and unit tests, participates in code review, and maintains technical documentation.

title: Senior Developer
description: Experienced developer who mentors juniors, leads complex implementations, and drives technical quality across the team.

title: Tester
description: Validates software against requirements. Writes and executes test cases, reports defects, and ensures quality gates are met before release.

title: QA Engineer
description: Designs the overall quality strategy. Defines test plans, automation frameworks, and non-functional test approaches for the project.

title: Scrum Master
description: Facilitates the Scrum process. Removes impediments, coaches the team on agile practices, and protects sprint goals from scope creep.

title: Stakeholder
description: Business representative with a vested interest in the outcome. Provides domain input, reviews demos, and approves changes within their area.

title: End User
description: The person who uses the product in daily work. Provides feedback on usability, participates in user testing and discovery interviews.

title: Security Officer
description: Ensures compliance with security policies and regulations. Reviews architecture for vulnerabilities and validates security controls before go-live.

title: Full Team
description: The entire delivery team participates. Used for ceremonies, retrospectives, or decisions requiring full team consensus and buy-in.
